summary: Controlled Calc presenters preserve canonical model/view ownership and use shared Writer visual controls.
findings: Reviewed ScGridWindow,ScInputWindow and ScTabControl against native composition and final Calc100percent evidence. Actual document and marks supply state;input/navigation remain controller-owned. Inline editor retains caret gestures and logical rows are distinct from physical browser scroll extent. Writer toolbar class string is preserved exactly in shared source;11related UI tests pass. Production app registration and command/workflow integration are explicitly not claimed.
residual_risks: Browser DOM/layout evidence is available; screenshot connector has a different allowed checkout root so no screenshot was saved outside Calc. Full visual/native fidelity and production Calc workbench remain incomplete. Native QA references are source anchors only.
